Name: Claudia
Summary: Claudia was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Eubulus, Pudens, and Linus.
KeyStory: Claudia was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Eubulus, Pudens, and Linus.
LifeLesson: Women stood among the believers who stayed with Paul in Rome.
